newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Spain-bound smugglers arrested at Bogota airport.
newsitem.headline: Spain-bound smugglers arrested at Bogota airport.

text.p: Eleven so-called "mules," people paid by traffickers to smuggle small quantities of cocaine and heroin out of Colombia, were caught at Bogota's airport on Wednesday as they prepared to board a flight for Spain.

A statement from the Metropolitan Police said the 11, seven men and four women, all belonged to the same "religious" tour group and claimed to be heading to Seville to pay homage to the Virgin of the Macarena.
Each of the 11 would-be travelers was discovered to have swallowed more than 70 rubber packets of cocaine, the statement said.
